name: paperaudit
description: Taxonomy mirroring the eight PaperAudit-Bench corruption types used to generate the ground truth.

categories.name: evidence_data_integrity
categories.description: Fabricated or altered data, statistics, or results: inflated dataset sizes, changed numbers in tables, results inconsistent with the cited source or with other parts of the paper.

categories.name: experimental_design_protocol
categories.description: Corrupted experimental setup: wrong or missing protocol details, impossible hyperparameters, flawed baselines or evaluation procedures, omitted reproducibility information.

categories.name: claim_interpretation_distortion
categories.description: Claims or interpretations distorted relative to the evidence: overstated conclusions, misread results, causal claims from correlational data.

categories.name: method_logic_consistency
categories.description: Logical breaks in the method: internally inconsistent formulations, equations or algorithms that contradict the described approach, dimension mismatches.

categories.name: context_misalignment_incoherence
categories.description: Passages that no longer cohere with their context: statements contradicting neighboring sections, misaligned terminology, references to content that doesn't exist.

categories.name: ethical_integrity_omission
categories.description: Removed or corrupted ethics-relevant content: missing consent/IRB statements, dropped limitations, hidden conflicts of interest, misrepresented human-subject procedures.

categories.name: rhetorical_presentation_manipulation
categories.description: Presentation manipulated to mislead: cherry-picked comparisons, misleading framing of negative results, unjustified superlatives about performance.

categories.name: reference_background_fabrication
categories.description: Fabricated or misattributed background and references: invented citations, wrong attribution of prior work, misstated related-work findings.
